semanticConstraints: PublicOrigin must be an exact absolute HTTPS origin with root path and no query/fragment; loopback HTTP requires Development and the explicit override.
Required selects DPoP-bound-token admission for authenticated requests; RequireNonce adds the server-issued single-use nonce requirement.
